blocks.html:
This method retrieves a paginated list of an RBAC role's assignments. An
assignment links the role to any entity (for example a user or an invite).
It sends a request to the List Role Assignments API route.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store/select-fields-and-relations).

children.name: limit
children.description: The maximum number of items to retrieve.

children.name: offset
children.description: The number of items to skip before retrieving the returned items.

children.name: order
children.description: The field to sort by and in which order.

children.name: with_deleted
children.description: Whether to include soft-deleted items in the results.

children.name: scope
children.description: Filter by the type of scope.

children.name: scope_id
children.description: Filter by the ID of the scope.

children.name: reference
children.description: Filter by the type of entity the role is assigned to (e.g. `user`, `invite`).

children.name: reference_id
children.description: Filter by the ID of the entity the role is assigned to.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: limit
children.description: The maximum number of items retrieved.

children.name: offset
children.description: The number of items to skip before retrieving the returned items.

children.name: count

children.name: estimate_count
children.description: The estimated count retrieved from the PostgreSQL query planner, which may be inaccurate.

deprecated.description: Use `count` instead. This property will be removed in the next minor release.

children.name: assignments
children.description: The list of role assignments.

children.name: id
children.description: The assignment's ID.

children.name: role_id
children.description: The ID of the role the assignment is for.

children.name: reference
children.description: The type of entity the role is assigned to (e.g. `user`, `invite`).

children.name: reference_id
children.description: The ID of the entity the role is assigned to.

children.name: scope
children.description:
The type of scope entity the assignment is constrained to (e.g.
`sales_channel`), if any.

children.name: scope_id
children.description: The ID of the scope entity the assignment is constrained to, if any.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Custom key-value pairs that can be added to the assignment.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date the assignment was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The date the assignment was updated.

children.name: deleted_at
